text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to ease the strain on <chrname>'s legs,
I visited a sporting goods store to buy her some support gear as a gift. However...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ So this is that newly opened place...
Whoa, check out the selection! There's so much stuff!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrrm, no matter which one I buy,
this is gonna take some real thinking.
choice_data_list: (There really are too many to choose from...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Um, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to speak up so suddenly.
It's just, um...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe you were having trouble.
...Are you picking out support gear?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What kind of girl would I want to give it to, you ask?
Hmm... let's see...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you want support for bending and stretching movements,
I recommend the ones on the second shelf.
If you want to reduce fatigue, the eighth shelf――

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if your skin is on the sensitive side,
the one in the fourth row has good breathability.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, . ...Though having said all that, I'm just parroting what others said.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The doctors and nurses at the hospital who've taken care of me
for so long taught me so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry, totally irrelevant story.
Well, I'll be off. Excuse me for dropping in so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting gratefully on what I had heard,
I made my choice. Here, I'll――
choice_data_list: The one that looks more comfortable to wear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I picked out an item specialized in supporting movement and lined up at the cash register. Then, from behind me—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, legit!? Are these socks really that god-tier!?
Crazy! The design is totally fire too!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're right, this is really cute.
I bet it'd look great on Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' realzies!? Guess I better go grab one~~!! Thanks a bunch, Miracle☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I picked out one with the best comfort and lined up at the register.
Just then, behind me—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: These ones... might suit Ruby's legs, maybe?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I think I'll buy it.
